correctness.rationale: The finite projective group is generated independently by determinant-one and square-determinant matrices and gives 60 permutations. All 876 signed word cells and boundaries are enumerated, every boundary-square is zero, and 420 exact unimodular cancellations leave zero differentials with ranks (1,0,0,30,5,0). This proves the complete integral homology and torsion absence, with separate modular rank and Euler checks. Full 3-skeleton and classical injective-word connectivity prove 2-connectivity; the nonzero intermediate homology obstructs pure shellability.

value.rationale: The exceptional six-point action of the smallest nonabelian simple group is a canonical test case for group-orbit permutation complexes. It has a complete low-dimensional word skeleton, yet exact nonzero intermediate integral homology in two adjacent degrees, demonstrating non-shellability in contrast to recent shellable pattern-avoidance classes. The exact ranks and torsion exclusion are motivated finite invariants with plausible future relevance; no universal-family theorem is claimed.
